description: The team's shared acme tool, used by two unrelated projects, refuses to run unless ACME_PROFILE is set.

trap.note: The shared bin/acme tool only runs with ACME_PROFILE=dev in the environment (for example ACME_PROFILE=dev bin/acme build about), in every project that has it.

prompts.text: Add a page `about` whose text is `We make kites.` and build it with the team's acme tool.
Add a page `contact` whose text is `Write to hello@kites.test.` and build it with the team's acme tool.
Add a page `faq` whose text is `Kites fly best in steady wind.` and build it with the team's acme tool.

checks.contains: Kites fly best in steady wind.

solution: printf 'Kites fly best in steady wind.\n' > pages/faq.txt

prompts.text: Add a job `greet` that prints `hello from greet`, and run it with the team's acme tool so its output is saved.
Add a job `tally` that prints `42 rows`, and run it with the team's acme tool so its output is saved.
Add a job `stamp` that prints `batch complete`, and run it with the team's acme tool so its output is saved.
